query: How much additional MediSave top-up do older Pioneer Generation seniors with serious pre-existing conditions receive annually between 2021 and 2025, and what can it be used for?
reference_answer: Older Pioneer Generation seniors with serious pre-existing conditions receive additional MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 annually from 2021 to 2025, which can be used to pay MediShield Life premiums.
